author: Zintenka
body:
My first map entry into atlas with Merp's awesome and spectacular co-authored assistance! There's gonna be more features for the map like teleports and TNT towers that allow players to shoot TNT but I don't know the XML modules for those...

Anyway, this is just a trial run into Atlas.


Features:
- 25v25
- 2 monuments for each side, first cuboid selected monument on Avicus :)
- Sides divided by biomes
- Teleports (In Avicus Version - for now)
- Mob spawners (Planned - for Atlas)
- TNT Towers (In Avicus Version - for now)

 -  Changed projectile from TNT to Wither skulls. Your bow now shoots wither skulls that damage the terrain and go at a lessened speed than before.

 -  Changed the tower leave region. Opposite team can enter the tower however, they cannot teleport to safety should they be knocked off. Be careful attackers!

 -  Fixed armor drops

 -  Changed iron sword to diamond sword
